newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde-March 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde-March 28.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Far-right party National Front holds congress in eastern city of Strasbourg this weekend, wide protests and demonstrations are expected.

-- State secretary for transports Anne-Marie Idrac says in an interview the state may subsidise some 40 domestic air routes after an April 1 air transport deregulation, adds state to keep stake in Air France after its privatisation.
-- Deutsche Morgan Grenfell to search for a bidder for Credit Foncier de France, which posted a 858 billion francs profit for 1996 after a 10.7 billion francs in 1995.
-- Pilots at Air Inter Europe call for a strike on March 31 and April 1, to protest conditions of planned merger with Air France.
-- Banque Rivaud posts a 917 million francs loss for 1996, due to provisions agaisnt client risks including Air Liberte.
-- French banks improve profitability, but structural problems remain.
